title: Variance of the normalized sum on the Boolean cube
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and on the uniform Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$ define $f(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^n(-1)^{x_i}$. Then $\operatorname{Var}(f)=1$.
replaced: If $n>0$ and $f(x)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(-1)^{x_i}$ on the uniform Boolean cube, then $\operatorname{Var}(f)=1$.
